title: Gaggle health response
description: Versioned read envelope for one gaggle's restart-recoverable health projection.

health.description: Current projection and bounded episode history.

state.description: Aggregate gaggle state or one finding's state contribution.

identity.description: Provider-neutral finding scope. Values are stable identifiers, never credentials, environment values, or host paths.

evidence.description: Bounded reference to authoritative, already-redacted journal or artifact evidence.

kind.description: Closed-by-producer evidence class, such as journal-event or artifact-digest.

run.description: Run containing the evidence, when applicable.

digest.description: Content digest of scrubbed evidence, when applicable.

detail.description: Bounded redacted explanation; raw logs and host-private paths are forbidden.

repair.description: Repair recommendation, independent policy authorization, attempt, result, and follow-up.

recommendedAction.description: Bounded recommended operator or automatic action.

policyAuthorized.description: Whether immutable product safety policy and gaggle policy both authorize automatic repair.

disposition.description: Observed repair lifecycle disposition, distinct from authorization.

attemptedAt.description: Time an authorized repair attempt started.

completedAt.description: Time the repair attempt produced a result.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable identity preventing duplicate mutation attempts.

resultSummary.description: Bounded redacted observed result; never unrestricted command output.

followUp.description: Required observation after a repair result.

finding.description: One deduplicated health episode with bounded evidence and explicit remediation phases.

severity.description: Finding severity after a safe override.

contribution.description: Finding contribution to deterministic aggregate state.

lastObserved.description: Most recent observation extending this episode.

observationCount.description: Number of repeated observations merged into this episode.

episodeKey.description: Stable dedupe key derived from finding code and non-secret scope.

evidence.description: Bounded authoritative evidence references supporting detection.

confidence.description: Detection confidence from zero through one.

evidenceAssessment.description: Why evidence is sufficient or insufficient, including uncertainty.

repair.description: Recommended action, authorization, attempt, observed result, and follow-up.

event.description: Append-only instance health-journal transition carrying a complete bounded finding snapshot.

finding.description: Complete finding snapshot for replay; absent only on evaluation.

snapshot.description: Derived current health and bounded resolved-episode history for one gaggle.

state.description: Deterministic aggregate state of active findings.

updatedAt.description: Time of the most recently replayed event.

active.description: Current unresolved episodes sorted by episode key.

history.description: Bounded resolved episode history for restart recovery and operator reads.

lastSequence.description: Last instance health-journal sequence included in the projection.
